settingsInfoProvidersIntro: How does MovieScout use your platforms?
settingsInfoProvidersItem1Desc: MovieScout periodically updates each title in your watchlist from TMDb (with streaming data from JustWatch) to detect where it is showing. If it matches any platform selected here, you get notified.
settingsInfoProvidersItem2Desc: Filter the catalog quickly to see only what you can watch with your active subscriptions.
settingsInfoProvidersItem3Desc: Platform availability adapts automatically to your selected region in settings.
settingsInfoNotificationsItem1Desc: Get notified when a title from your watchlist becomes available on your chosen platforms.
settingsInfoNotificationsItem2Desc: By default you are alerted on the first episode. If complete season is enabled, alerts wait until the full season airs.
settingsInfoNotificationsItem3Desc: MovieScout checks for updates quietly in the background without draining your battery.
settingsInfoAiItem1Desc: Generates natural synopses and title translations adapted to cinematic context when not available in your language.
settingsInfoAiItem2Desc: Find movies by describing scenes, plot points, or themes even if you do not recall the title.
settingsInfoAiItem3Desc: Your API key is stored securely on your device and only used for your direct requests.
settingsInfoAiNote: Important: Free AI models may experience slower response times or temporary rate limits.
settingsInfoProfileItem1Desc: Allow others to find your profile, follow you, and see what you are watching and your ratings.
settingsInfoProfileItem2Desc: Switch to private mode anytime. Only public titles and ratings are shared, never personal data or keys.
settingsInfoProfileItem3Desc: Show or hide the community tab in the bottom bar based on your preference.
settingsInfoEditIntro: Help grow the open database and improve movie information.
settingsInfoEditItem1Desc: Displays a pencil icon on movie and series details to quickly open their editing page on TMDb.
settingsInfoEditItem2Desc: All MovieScout information comes from The Movie Database (TMDb), a collaborative project maintained by the community.
settingsInfoEditItem3Desc: You can add or correct titles, overviews, and details in any language for the entire community to enjoy.
settingsInfoEditNote: To edit content on TMDb, you only need to sign in with a free account at themoviedb.org.
